meta.note: Package 36 P4, package 37 P2: the races of the game module ranniag (Wp_claude/RACES_SOURCE.md); only what affects the character; texts of narrative abilities in English (the owner's source).

entries.name: Азана

abilities.name: Бег на четырёх
abilities.text: With nothing in the hands she may run on all fours: speed 30 ft per action (tick the box).

abilities.name: Зрение красного солнца
abilities.text: Darkvision 60 ft; sees colours at half that distance. Cannot be blinded or dazzled.

abilities.name: Динамо
abilities.text: Static pool = 10 x level. Electric damage is taken from the pool first. A melee attack may spend from the pool the squares moved this round and add the same electric damage (spend by hand).

abilities.name: Неубиваемый монстр
abilities.text: Below 0 HP she keeps her actions and is not dying: she gets 'confused' (rolls twice and chooses). With a non-zero static pool and HP below 1: regeneration 5 (acid, fire) and -2 static each turn; physical damage to herself turns the regeneration off for a round.

triggers.text: Unkillable monster: static > 0 and HP < 1 -> regeneration 5 (turn it on)

abilities.name: Конец сессии
abilities.text: At the end of every session injury points (OT) received are lowered by 4 (press the button).

abilities.name: Голодный монстр
abilities.text: Cannot get sick or poisoned from food / water; eats half as much. Any unusual potion except holy water gives 1 extra comfort (add it by hand).

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

statuses.name: Статическая регенерация
statuses.text: Regeneration 5 (acid, fire) while static > 0 and HP < 1; -2 static each turn.

entries.name: Белая дева

abilities.name: Зрение мёртвых
abilities.text: Ignores darkness; senses the living within 60 ft.

abilities.name: Копирование
abilities.text: Gets one feat and one racial ability of the body she parasitizes. No effects of its own: take them from the catalog and link the taken feat / ability here (held by).

abilities.name: Марионетка
abilities.text: In negative HP acts as usual; effective pain lowered by 2; at the start of each combat temporary HP = 2 x level; natural regeneration minimal; healing from spells halved. The smoke form when the body is destroyed is PARKED (needs the creature card).

abilities.name: Одержимость
abilities.text: As a haze: drain the living for 2d6 days, then pour the force into a recently dead body; shadow attack (the enemy loses an action, d4 acid); spying in a shadow. Text only (the GM rolls).

abilities.name: Принципиальность
abilities.text: Every white maiden has a principle (a character trait) because of which she has not killed people; a quirk that helps to keep it at the GM's discretion.

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

quirks.name: Принцип девы
quirks.text: The principle of the maiden (the GM names the quirk).

entries.name: Лунный эльф

abilities.name: Авангард
abilities.text: The first ten feet over heavy terrain per round ignore the speed penalty.

abilities.name: Первобытное зрение
abilities.text: Darkvision 120 ft, colours at the whole distance; triple vision in low light. Dazzled in bright light.

abilities.name: Сохранение состояния
abilities.text: While HP and BP are positive they lose characteristics only from injuries (not from poisons, diseases, spells).

abilities.name: Медитация
abilities.text: Cannot be put to sleep. Short rest 4 hours, no perception penalty; may spend 3 BP for the long-rest benefits (BP back only in a safe place).

abilities.name: Танец с клинками
abilities.text: The first attack against the elf in a combat may be declared a miss before the roll. +3 spirit: the attack makes the enemy vulnerable; +5 spirit: the charge is not spent (spend the spirit by hand). The charge comes back at the start of every combat.

abilities.name: Тень Сантерры
abilities.text: Twice per full rest, 3 actions: walk up to four times the speed, invisible d4 rounds; notices incorporeal enemies within 60 ft and may hit them for double damage without breaking invisibility.

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

statuses.name: Танец с клинками
statuses.text: The first attack against the elf in a combat may be declared a miss before the roll. +3 spirit: the attack makes the enemy vulnerable; +5 spirit: the charge is not spent (spend the spirit by hand). The charge comes back at the start of every combat.

entries.name: Мордон

abilities.name: +2 к любой
abilities.text: +2 to any characteristic: tick ONE box 'Mordon +2 ...'.

abilities.name: Очищение крови
abilities.text: If a negative status affects them they may lose 4 HP to shorten it by 1 round (by hand).

abilities.name: Полуночный инстинкт
abilities.text: Keep the dodge bonus against melee attacks from behind (the back cells do not lose Dex); sense an aggressive creature within 120 ft.

abilities.name: Зрение красного солнца
abilities.text: Darkvision 60 ft, colours at half that distance. Cannot be blinded or dazzled.

abilities.name: История выживания
abilities.text: Roll 1d20 when taking the race (outside the program): 1-5 type 1, 6-10 type 2, 11-14 type 3, 15-16 type 4, 17-18 type 5, 19-20 type 6; then take that history.

abilities.name: Пир воронов
abilities.text: +2 Dex, speed 30 ft, immune to fear; drawback: must leave combat without rolls at pressure -5.

triggers.text: Feast of Ravens: pressure -5 -> leave the combat

abilities.name: Выкуп: Пир воронов
abilities.text: The drawback is bought out.

abilities.name: Стена костей
abilities.text: +2 Con, the feat Toughness for free (added and linked here), no wound penalty (no pain penalty; pain and OT still accrue); drawbacks: -4 CMD, bleeding hits x2 (a reminder while a bleeding status is on: the player sets the bleeding himself), comfort per fight 1 less and at most 3.

abilities.name: Выкуп: Стена костей
abilities.text: The drawbacks are bought out: CMD back, no bleeding x2 reminder, the normal comfort per fight.

abilities.name: Знамя крови
abilities.text: +2 Str; animal handling specialised and a free mount up to CR3; mounted DR 2/-; drawback: 1 comfort less for fights.

abilities.name: Выкуп: Знамя крови
abilities.text: The drawback is bought out.

abilities.name: Падший Данталиана
abilities.text: +2 Int; extra weapon group and focus (Flails and Chains), +1 divine slot of the 1st circle, mana +3; Cause Fear, Protection from Good, Ray of Enfeeblement (caster level at least 1, Charisma); counts as evil; drawback: 25 % less experience.

abilities.name: Выкуп: Падший Данталиана
abilities.text: The drawback is bought out (full experience again).

abilities.name: Богиня человечности
abilities.text: +2 Wis; allies may reroll one d20 once (back after the long rest); out of combat once per short rest 10 HP to each ally; +2 caster level for divine magic; drawback: -4 on the first five attacks of each combat: 5 charges, spend one per attack; the -4 counts in combat while a charge is left; the charges come back at the start of every combat.

abilities.name: Выкуп: Богиня человечности
abilities.text: The drawback is bought out.

abilities.name: Возврат к нулю
abilities.text: +2 Cha; once per adventure restore all spirit; once per six sessions at the first death 6d6 HP and half spirit; no effects of the evil gods' pressure in Santerra; drawback: -5 base points. The charge (once per adventure) is restored by hand.

abilities.name: Выкуп: Возврат к нулю
abilities.text: The drawback is bought out.

abilities.name: Золотое величие
abilities.text: Up to 5000 MZ on jewellery worn constantly: per 1000 MZ an extra history roll (duplicates ignored). Take the extra history and set its 'held by' to the jewellery item: if the jewellery is lost the history is 'not backed'; paid-off drawbacks are remembered.

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

entries.name: Отражённый

abilities.name: Перерождение
abilities.text: Once per half-year, instead of deadly direct damage: back to full HP and a new appearance; after the session rearrange characteristics and drives at random; may reset the level and get 10 comfort.

triggers.text: Rebirth: full HP, a new appearance; after the session rearrange characteristics and drives

abilities.name: Зрение красного солнца
abilities.text: Darkvision 60 ft, colours at half that distance. Cannot be blinded or dazzled.

abilities.name: Самосбывающееся пророчество
abilities.text: Between sessions spend 1-20 spirit and announce a desired future; the GM gives hints. One at a time.

abilities.name: Хамелеон
abilities.text: Disguise and stealth are advanced skills with racial +4; diplomacy, empathy and bluff racial +2.

abilities.name: Благословение богини Ноль
abilities.text: +4 to all rolls during combat while the combat pressure equals zero.

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

entries.name: Рахим

abilities.name: Драконьи крылья
abilities.text: Racial +4 to sleight, athletics and acrobatics.

abilities.name: Полёт
abilities.text: Fly 20 ft (average).

abilities.name: Хороший полёт
abilities.text: Flight becomes good.

abilities.name: Драконий хвост
abilities.text: With a melee attack: -2 AC until the next zero-initiative tick (the button turns the status on) and a tail hit: a natural attack 1d8, no extra attack penalty, the iterative penalty applies, no multi-attack penalty (the natural attack itself is parked).

triggers.text: Dragon tail: -2 AC until the next tick; tail 1d8

abilities.name: Драконье зрение
abilities.text: Darkvision 60 ft, colours over the whole distance.

abilities.name: Драконья чешуя
abilities.text: SR 12 + level; resistance to fire and electricity 5.

abilities.name: Намерение в слове
abilities.text: +4 diplomacy and intimidation, -6 bluff. Breaking his highlighted word costs 100 training (by hand; without training he sells characteristics).

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

statuses.name: Драконий хвост
statuses.text: -2 AC until the next zero-initiative tick.

entries.name: Серебряный эльф

abilities.name: Авангард
abilities.text: The first ten feet over heavy terrain per round ignore the speed penalty.

abilities.name: Первобытное зрение
abilities.text: Darkvision 120 ft, colours at the whole distance; triple vision in low light. Dazzled in bright light.

abilities.name: Целостность
abilities.text: While HP are maximal: +2 dodge to AC and racial +4 to CMB and CMD. Bleeding closes by itself in 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Чистый разум
abilities.text: Cannot be charmed, immune to confusion. Short rest 4 hours, no perception penalty. With maximal BP racial +2 to Will.

abilities.name: Танец с клинками
abilities.text: The first attack against the elf in a combat may be declared a miss before the roll. +3 spirit: the attack makes the enemy vulnerable; +5 spirit: the charge is not spent (spend the spirit by hand). The charge comes back at the start of every combat.

abilities.name: Искоренение скверны
abilities.text: Twice per full rest, 1 action: a humanoid within 30 ft is a heretic: Will DC 14 + level / 2 or for three minutes his characteristics cannot exceed 10 and racial features do not work (a magical effect).

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

statuses.name: Танец с клинками
statuses.text: The first attack against the elf in a combat may be declared a miss before the roll. +3 spirit: the attack makes the enemy vulnerable; +5 spirit: the charge is not spent (spend the spirit by hand). The charge comes back at the start of every combat.

statuses.name: Искоренение скверны
statuses.text: Heretic: Will DC 14 + level / 2 (the GM rolls).

entries.name: Скерде

abilities.name: Житель моря
abilities.text: Swim 15 ft per action.

abilities.name: Задержка дыхания
abilities.text: Holds breath for twenty minutes.

abilities.name: Коллекция трофеев
abilities.text: Destroying 2 items from one monster gives a trophy with ilvl + 1 (by hand). Per base slot of trophies racial +1 to athletics, perception and stealth; per two slots +1 to saves; per four slots +1 Cha. Tag the trophy items 'trophy' and keep them at the base.

abilities.name: Тщательная экспедиция
abilities.text: HP equal to the number of base slots, at most 4 x level (in the race effects).

abilities.name: Чувство зыби
abilities.text: Low-light vision and blindsense 20 ft.

abilities.name: Гибкость морского хищника
abilities.text: Maximum damage in a grapple; breaking free restores the actions spent on it (by hand).

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

entries.name: Рагмал

abilities.name: Пылающий взгляд
abilities.text: Eyes give bright light 20 ft; may be suppressed.

abilities.name: Магическое тело
abilities.text: +6 mana at level 1 (in the race effects) even without a class. Mana is used before HP when taking damage. Trains mana at 200 training per unit: the catalog training 'Mana training' (Training tab). +1 Str per 10 maximum mana.

abilities.name: Бездонное брюхо
abilities.text: Unusual food gives extra training 10 x its ilvl, tripled for raising mana (by hand).

abilities.name: Благословение богини людей
abilities.name_en: Blessing of the goddess of people
abilities.text: +3 maximum carried weight, racial +2 Fortitude, +3 balance, natural regeneration doubled.

abilities.name: Тяжёлый замах
abilities.text: Hitting with a two-handed weapon or a natural attack: 2 temporary HP until the next zero-initiative tick (the button turns the status on).

triggers.text: Heavy swing: 2 temporary HP until the next tick

abilities.name: Охота на воплощения
abilities.text: At the start of combat, an instant action: spend 4 mana for +1 fire or acid damage on all attacks and spells until the end of combat; cumulative (every use adds one stack). Press 'spend 4 mana', then '+1 stack'.

triggers.text: Hunt for incarnations: +1 fire / acid damage until the end of combat

entries.text: Languages: choose two languages of the region (add them by hand).

statuses.name: Тяжёлый замах
statuses.text: 2 temporary HP until the next zero-initiative tick.

statuses.name: Охота на воплощения
statuses.text: +1 fire or acid damage per stack on all attacks and spells until the end of combat.
